Complete source work only after verifying dependencies, acceptance and actual evidence reports

Usage: awr work complete [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --reason <REASON> --input <INPUT> --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION> <WORK>

Arguments:
  <WORK>  

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>
          [default: .]
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --json
          
      --reason <REASON>
          
      --input <INPUT>
          JSON acceptance-to-evidence mapping (version 1, at most 64 KiB)
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>
          
      --response-view <RESPONSE_VIEW>
          [default: full] [possible values: full, summary]
      --end-session
          End the session in the same request once the work is completed. Refused while the session still holds claims on other work
  -h, --help
          Print help
